verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly mention testing a build 'in Preview' before publishing (replit-docs-15, replit-docs-22), and the publish flow is described as a separate, deliberate step after development (replit-docs-8), implying a live pre-publish preview environment exists. However, there is no detailed documentation of the preview's interactivity, no independent/hands-on confirmation of the live-preview experience, and community evidence focuses on unrelated issues (agent reliability, git conflicts) rather than the preview itself. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the live preview UI/interaction model, independent user corroboration of using the preview during iteration.
